name: Personalized Blind Box Advent Calendar with Charms
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Premium paper box with a durable full-color printed finish for a festive and eye-catching presentation.
    - Includes a sturdy transparent plastic blister tray with 24 individual compartments to hold each charm securely.
    - Features 24 personalized charms, available in either 3 mm acrylic or 3 mm natural wood.
    - Comes with 10 sets of hanging strings (3 string styles per set) for decorating your Christmas tree or holiday display.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Advent Calendar Box: 7.09 × 10.24 × 1.18 in ~ 18 × 26 × 3 cm
    - Plastic Blister Tray: 9.96 × 6.89 x 1.1  in ~ 25.3 × 17.5 x 2.8 cm
    - Each compartment size: 1.38 1.38 in ~ 3.5 x 3.5 cm
    - Individual Charm Size: 1.18 × 1.18 in ~ 3 × 3 cm
    📌 Note: The shape of the paper box and plastic blister tray is fixed and cannot be changed. The charm dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - High-definition UV printing for vibrant, long-lasting colors.
    - All-over print on the paper box and both sides of the charm.

 

  • Function & Usage:
    - Designed as a fun countdown calendar with 24 individual compartments to hold personalized charms, small gifts, notes, or surprises.
    - Includes 24 custom-shaped acrylic or wooden charms (3 mm thick) and 10 sets of hanging strings in assorted styles, allowing you to turn each charm into a keepsake ornament.
    - Reusable paper box and removable blister tray make it easy to refill with new surprises for future celebrations.
    - Perfect for decorating Christmas trees, bedrooms, offices, classrooms, shelves, or displaying cherished collectible charms all year round.
    - A meaningful way to create daily excitement, celebrate milestones, and build lasting memories with family, friends, or loved ones.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful personalized gift for Christmas, Birthdays, Anniversaries, Valentine's Day, Mother's Day, Father's Day, Graduations, Baby Showers, Weddings, Housewarmings, and New Year's celebrations.
    - Great for families, couples, kids, friends, classmates, teachers, coworkers, or anyone who enjoys personalized keepsakes and daily surprises.
    - Ideal as a countdown gift box, memory collection, party favor, holiday decoration, or unique keepsake that can be treasured and reused year after year.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 - 3 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Personalized Blind Box Advent Calendar with Charms

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.1 - 0.3  cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as an .emb, .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
